## prompt-2-draft-ind

*Generated by Process A from [`../prompts/prompt-ind.md`](../prompts/prompt-ind.md),
adapting the `trial-protocol/sub-prompts/prompt-2-draft-protocol.md` convention.
Runs in stage `trial-ind/draft-ind/`.*

Author the **Stage 2 draft IND scaffold** into `trial-ind/draft-ind/`. The draft
is the first paper-file set: it lays out every section of the ReGARDD IND Table
of Contents as its own `sections/sec-*.tex` file and fills each with bracketed
`[DRAFTING INSTRUCTION]` markers (via the `\draftinstr{...}` macro) that name the
exact `physical-ai-oncology-trials` repository files and directories the full
stage will process.

**Files (one commit each, Rule 6).**
- `main.tex` - cover page (the COVER PAGE block verbatim), front matter, clickable
  Table of Contents after the Introduction, `\input` of every section, and the
  back matter. `\clearpage` per major section.
- `indstyle.sty` - the shared grayscale style (adapts
  `regulatory/Adaption-21-CFR-Part-312/source/Physical_AI_21_CFR_Part_312.sty` plus
  the `trial-documents/final-paper/publication/paperstyle.sty` primitives; black
  body / links / headings; eight-tone grayscale `mm*` figure styles; a back-matter
  section command).
- `references.bib` - copied from `../inputs/references.bib`, extended with any new
  `@misc` entries in the identical format (clickable `url`, DOI text plus clickable
  DOI URL).
- `README.md` - comprehensive, with badges and the Rule 5 cross-reference table.

**Section files (one commit each, Rule 6).** One `.tex` per top-level TOC item:
`sec-00-cover-letter`, `sec-01-fda-forms`, `sec-02-introduction`,
`sec-03-general-investigational-plan`, `sec-04-investigator-brochure`,
`sec-05-proposed-clinical-research`, `sec-06-cmc`,
`sec-07-pharmacology-toxicology`, `sec-08-previous-human-experience`,
`sec-09-additional-information`, `sec-10-relevant-information`,
`sec-11-references-backmatter`.

**Sources to name in the bracketed instructions (Rule 5).**
`trial-protocol/final-protocol/publication/sections/*` (clinical content, tables,
quantitative data); `trial-documents/final-paper/publication/sections/*` (the
acceleration argument and the figures adapted in context);
`trial-documents/inputs/llm-adoption` (PI large-document guidance);
`trial-ind/inputs/ReGARDD_IND_Template.docx` (section order and required content);
`trial-ind/inputs/FDA-1571_Instructions_R14_03-21-2023.md` (1571 / 3674 fields);
`trial-ind/inputs/ReGARDD-Regulatory-Guidance-for-Academic-Research-of-Drugs-and-Devices.md`
(academic IND guidance); `trial-ind/mermaid/fig-01 .. fig-22` (figure pointers);
`trial-ind/inputs/references.bib` (citations).

**Commit schedule.** `.sty`, `main.tex`, `.bib`, `README` (4 commits) plus 12
section commits, all pushed in real time. The second-to-last commit fixes all
errors. The last commit ships `draft-ind-LaTeX.zip` (compiles in Overleaf with
pdfLaTeX) and `output-draft-ind.md`. No `png` / `jpg`; single dashes; `§`.
